text_edits.old: bottom=.25,top=.84

\paragraph{Conditional correction outperforms permanent reweighting and deeper search.}
Applying the $10\times$ multiplier permanently rescues 50 failures but \textbf{breaks 32 episodes that native MPC solves}, for less than half the net gain of ECP (\cref{tab:timing}). Triggered ECP preserves every native success while recovering \textbf{39 failures}, modifying the cost only where native planning has stalled. Deeper search does not resolve stalls either: a lookahead planner evaluating candidate prefixes improves net success only marginally while introducing \textbf{27 regressions}, and adding lookahead to ECP is worse than ECP alone. These controls support correcting the objective rather than only increasing search.
text_edits.new:
\paragraph{Conditional correction outperforms permanent reweighting and deeper search.}
Permanent $10\times$ weighting rescues 50 failures but \textbf{breaks 32 native successes}, yielding less than half ECP's net gain (\cref{tab:timing}). Triggered ECP instead recovers \textbf{39 failures without regressions}. Lookahead search adds \textbf{27 regressions} for only a marginal net gain; combining it with ECP also underperforms ECP alone. These controls favor correcting the stalled objective over increasing search.

text_edits.old:
\paragraph{Loss-gated coordination complements online adaptation.}
On Maze with online adaptation, correcting at the first stall recovers 7 failures but loses 4 native successes, and a fixed delay is worse than not correcting (\cref{tab:maze-controls}). Freezing adaptation at the stall point without correcting the objective collapses 50-replan success from 82\% to 60\% (\cref{tab:maze-full}). The loss gate (\cref{eq:gate}) avoids both pitfalls, retaining every native success at 30 replans and reaching 87\% at 50 replans.
text_edits.new:
\paragraph{Loss-gated coordination complements online adaptation.}
On Maze with adaptation, immediate correction rescues 7 failures but loses 4 native successes; a fixed delay is worse than no correction (\cref{tab:maze-controls}). Freezing adaptation at a stall without correcting the objective reduces 50-replan success from 82\% to 60\% (\cref{tab:maze-full}). The loss gate (\cref{eq:gate}) preserves all native successes at 30 replans and reaches 87\% at 50 replans.
